blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The PBA has revoked the franchise of the company that owns the Titan Ultra Giant Risers, citing violations of the league’s constitution and by-laws. A press release issued by the league said that Pureblends was axed from the league for “gross misrepresentation in securing a PBA franchise,” “lack of financial capacity,” and “unauthorized change in ownership and control.” The league actually voted to terminate Pureblends’ membership during a meeting last Nov. 19. PBA commissioner Willie Marcial refrained from making further statements on the matter while legal counsel Ogie Narvasa was unavailable as of posting time.
